native_audit.source: Native base-world snapshot; no native spawn moves under the polish policy.

residents.name: Dawnchaser Medical Volunteer
residents.greeting: Nala is beside the medical tent. Kang cooks at the hearth, and Kor watches the road. Ask Dezco if you need another antidote or food for the families.

residents.name: Barrelbottom Supply Clerk
residents.greeting: Mei is keeping the relief wagons moving. Ken-Ken is with the families in the small camp southwest of here; follow the road before turning toward their tents.

residents.name: Village Relief Carpenter
residents.greeting: Ken-Ken tends the families, Kang prepares their medicine, and Maruut studies the well. The provisioner, herbalist and toolkeeper are here among the tents.

residents.name: Wildhammer Table Steward
residents.greeting: Iain welcomes travelers of either banner at this table. You can meet him here without entering Aerie Peak. Take a seat and catch your breath.

residents.name: Expedition Quartermaster
residents.greeting: Maruut and Ortell are beside the supply wagon. Bring any rescued surveyors to our banner; I will see that they have food and dry blankets.

residents.name: Twilight Quartermaster
residents.greeting: Papers first. Condenna handles admission and fire trials; Cargall preserves supplicants. Mylva drills body and mind, and Devoran trains the hounds.
